# Ruby Gillis

[Academy](../codex/places.md#academy)

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P1](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0001)</sub>

- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_
- **Family:** [Susan](../character/susan.md) (sibling)

## Appearance

Ruby Gillis possesses showy looks, highlighted by her brilliant complexion and large, bright-blue eyes. She has a plump, showy figure and wears her yellow hair in a long braid.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P43](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0043), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P1](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0001)_

## Personality

Ruby Gillis is a cheerful, good-tempered individual who enjoys the pleasant things in life and is known to be sentimental, though she is also inclined to hysterical outbursts when overwhelmed. She is heavily focused on young men and romantic attention, frequently speaking about boys and the compliments she receives. Her main ambitions involve having numerous suitors captivated by her, securing a romantic partner by age fifteen, and teaching for only two years before getting married.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P39](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0039), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. ## History

Growing up alongside [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), Ruby Gillis attended school and Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#academy) with her. As a young girl, she declared her intention to have dozens of beaus when she grew up, a pursuit that later yielded numerous suitors and fueled local gossip. Among her admirers, Nelson Atkins proposed to her, though he did so using a line copied from an etiquette book; upon discovering this, Ruby went home and wrote him a scathing refusal.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P1](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P14](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0014), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P18](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0018), [v1 CHAPTER XV. ## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--ruby-gillis.md)

Ruby is a schoolmate and friend of [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md). The two share treats and attend [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school together, maintaining a warm camaraderie. Ruby also participates in social gatherings alongside [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and visited her during Anne's recovery from a broken ankle.

- Friend of — schoolmates who share treats  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P13](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0013), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P20](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0020), [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P60](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0060)</sub>

### [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/gilbert-blythe--ruby-gillis.md)

Ruby and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) are schoolmates who travel home together along with their peer group. Though [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) is largely focused on his intense academic rivalry and personal history with [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), he and Ruby remain regular companions on the walk from school.

- Comrade of — traveling companion who walks home with her  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P1](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0001)</sub>

### [Susan](../character/susan.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/ruby-gillis--susan.md)

[Susan](../character/susan.md) is Ruby's sister. They grow up together in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) as part of the local peer group during their school years.

- Sibling of — sister  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXVI. The Story Club Is Formed P17](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0017)</sub>

### [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/diana-barry--ruby-gillis.md)

Ruby is a long-standing friend and classmate of [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), joining her and their fellow students for weekend gatherings and school events. Their shared social circle includes attending parties, participating in outdoor games, and gathering for Saturday visits.

- Friend of — old friends reunited for Saturdays (since v2)  <sub>[v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P60](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0060)</sub>
